dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product opens, from a control a person presses, a small surface that stands beside that control and holds something to read and act on — a few settings, a short form, a note with a link, a set of filters — while the rest of the page stays usable around it; and it wants that surface to look and behave like its menus and its docked pickers, which are the same kind of thing.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a popover reads: the container's color, elevation, corner shape, paddings, the gap between its parts, its least and greatest width and its greatest height; the distance to its anchor and to the window's edges; the arrow; the header's gap, the headline's color and text style and the close button's variant; the content color; the dividers shown while the content scrolls; how the actions are arranged, their default Button variant and their spacing; and the open and close motion.
rules: A popover is opened by a press on a control and holds content a person can operate. Something that opens on hover or focus and only describes its anchor is a tooltip; a list of commands or choices is a menu; something the task cannot go on without is a dialog.
A popover is not modal: no scrim, no focus trap, nothing behind it inert. Escape, a press outside it and focus leaving it close it.
Say where it goes with placement, offset and crossOffset; never position it by hand. It flips, shifts and follows its anchor by itself.
Give it a name: headline where it draws one, label where it does not.

Its close button and its actions are Tanrei Buttons with Button's own tokens; the popover names only their variant. Re-value comp.popover.close-button.variant, comp.popover.actions.variant and comp.popover.actions.arrangement in a layer to change every popover of a product.
The container's color, elevation and shape have the menu's values by default so that every surface that opens from a control reads as one family; a system that sets one apart sets these tokens.
A component that draws an anchored surface of its own (a select, a combobox, a docked picker) keeps its own tokens and cites the popover's rules; it does not read comp.popover.

color.$description: The popover's sheet: the menu's, the docked picker's and the search view's color, so that every surface that opens from a control is the same sheet.

elevation.$description: The level of the menu's sheet: above the page and its raised parts, below a dialog.

padding-inline.$description: From the container's start and end edges to the header, the content (while inset) and the actions.

padding-block.$description: From the container's top and bottom edges to its first and last part.

gap.$description: Between the header and the content.

min-width.$description: The least width of a popover sized by its content: the menu's, so that the popover and the menu one control could open are never narrower than each other.

max-width.$description: The greatest width of a popover sized by its content; longer content wraps. Wider than a menu (a popover holds sentences and fields, a menu holds labels), narrower than a dialog.

max-height.$description: The greatest height of a popover, whatever room the window has; taller content scrolls between the header and the actions. A popover that would need more is a dialog's or a sheet's content.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product keeps its popovers small beside the control that opened them: on a tall window a long list of filters scrolls inside the surface rather than growing into a column that hides the page it filters.

offset.$description: The gap between the anchor's edge and the nearest part of the popover, on the side the popover is placed: the container's edge, or the arrow's tip while an arrow is drawn. A popover whose offset prop is set uses that in its place. The menu's and the tooltip's distance.

window-margin.$description: The least distance between the popover and the edges of the window's safe area and the on-screen keyboard; the popover flips, shifts, narrows or, in a window smaller than itself, covers its anchor to keep it.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product points some of its popovers, or all of them, at the control that opened them — on a crowded toolbar, or where the surface stands apart from a small control, the side alone does not say which control it belongs to — and tunes how large that pointer is.

visible.$description: Whether a popover whose arrow the product did not set draws one (POP-10). off: the container alone, as a menu. on: a triangle on the edge that faces the anchor. A popover whose arrow is set keeps what it was given. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once whether its popovers point at their anchors, and still draws a single one the other way.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

width.$description: The arrow's base, along the container's edge. The tooltip's.

height.$description: From the container's edge to the arrow's tip. The container stands this much farther from the anchor while an arrow is drawn, so the tip keeps the offset.

inset.$description: The least distance between the arrow's base and either end of the edge it stands on. Where the corner radius is larger, the radius is the least distance, so the arrow never stands on a curve.

gap.$description: Between the headline and the close button.

typescale.$description: The smallest heading: a popover's headline labels a small surface. The rich tooltip's title has the same style; a dialog's headline is one step larger.

variant.$description: The Button variant of the close button, an icon-only small Button (POP-13): tonal in the default system, as every host's close button is. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once how its popovers' close control stands: a tonal button that reads as a control on any content, or a bare glyph that leaves a small header to its headline.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material 3 closes a surface with a standard icon button, which is Tanrei's text Button with an icon only, as the side sheet's here. Keeps the preset's look; the change to a tonal close button is the default system's.

color.$description: Handed to the content as the platform's inherited foreground.
The one hairline, below the header and above the actions while the content scrolls.

visibility.$description: When the dividers below the header and above the actions are drawn while the content scrolls between them. always: both, whenever the content scrolls, wherever it is scrolled to. scroll: below the header only while the content is scrolled away from its top, above the actions only while more of it lies below (POP-8). Under either choice none is drawn while everything fits, or where there is no header or no action on that side. Follows the system's choice; the dividerVisibility prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product rules a popover's fixed header and actions off from its scrolling content for as long as it scrolls, while another shows each line only once content has passed it; a small surface anchored to a control may be set apart from the dialogs and sheets of the same product.

gap.$description: Between two actions, in a row or stacked. At sys.target.touch minus the lowest Button (small, 32) or more, every action keeps its whole target in a column, as comp.dialog.actions.gap and comp.side-sheet.actions.gap do.

margin-block-start.$description: Between the content (or the header, where there is no content) and the actions.

arrangement.$description: How the actions sit. fill: a full-width Button group, the actions sharing the container's inner width equally. end: at their own widths, aligned to the end. Either stacks into a column when the row does not fit (POP-15). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once how the actions at the foot of its popovers sit: as equal, full-width targets, as its dialogs' and sheets' do, or as a compact row at the end that leaves a small surface's width to its content.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

variant.$description: The Button variant the popover gives an action whose variant the product did not set (POP-16). An action whose variant is set keeps it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product chooses the emphasis of its popovers' actions once, for every popover, rather than on each Button.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

open-duration.$description: How long the container takes to appear from the anchor's side: an anchored surface's entrance.

close-duration.$description: How long the container takes to leave the way it came: an anchored surface's exit.
